ValidationRule.description: Throws an error when the Status changes and External System or External Case ID is null.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, AND( ISCHANGED(Status), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status,'Open'))), OR( ISPICKVAL(External_System__c,''), ISNULL(External_Case_ID__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: These fields are required in order to change Status to Under Investigation - External System and External Case ID.
